segments.text: This is the sixth video presentation for the Case Animal and Plant Biotechnology Course.
segments.zh: 这是 CASE 动物与植物生物技术课程的第六个视频讲解。

segments.text: As you view this video, be sure to make notes of important information.
segments.zh: 观看本视频时，请务必记下重要信息。

segments.text: Feel free to pause, repeat, and resume the video whenever necessary.
segments.zh: 必要时可以随时暂停、重播和继续播放视频。

segments.text: Culturing Carrots Lesson 4.2, Performance Enhanced Plants.
segments.zh: 培养胡萝卜　第 4.2 课　性能增强型植物。

segments.text: Your teacher introduced Problem 424, The Complete Carrot.
segments.zh: 你的老师已经介绍了问题 4.2.4“完整的胡萝卜”。

segments.text: As you consider how to propagate carrots, remember what tools and processes you used to propagate ferns earlier in the lesson.
segments.zh: 在考虑如何繁殖胡萝卜时，回想一下本课前面繁殖蕨类植物时用过的工具和流程。

segments.text: This presentation will provide additional information about carrot culture.
segments.zh: 本讲解将提供有关胡萝卜培养的更多信息。

segments.text: This diagram gives a good overview of the basic steps involved in the carrot culture process you will use during Problem 424, The Complete Carrot.
segments.zh: 这张图很好地概述了你在问题 4.2.4“完整的胡萝卜”中将要使用的胡萝卜培养流程的基本步骤。

segments.text: Carrot plants have a taproot system which stores energy. This taproot is the vegetable many of us are accustomed to eating.
segments.zh: 胡萝卜植株具有储存能量的主根系统。这个主根就是我们很多人习惯食用的蔬菜。

segments.text: For tissue culture purposes, we will use the same structure to produce clones in an in vitro environment in order to complete the process of tissue culture.
segments.zh: 在组织培养中，我们将利用同样的结构在离体环境中产生克隆，从而完成组织培养的过程。

segments.text: The callus can take anywhere from two to six weeks to develop.
segments.zh: 愈伤组织的形成需要两到六周不等。

segments.text: After that time, the callus can be transferred into a rooting medium containing oxens for root and shoot development.
segments.zh: 之后，可以把愈伤组织转移到含有生长素的生根培养基中，促进根和芽的发育。

segments.text: After another six to eight weeks, tiny roots and shoots will form.
segments.zh: 再过六到八周，就会长出细小的根和芽。

segments.text: Plantlets will grow into clusters if they are too close in the medium.
segments.zh: 如果小植株在培养基中靠得太近，就会长成一簇一簇的。

segments.text: To separate the plantlets, you will need to maintain a sterile environment and use disinfecting solution on the tools, just as you did during the initial culturing process.
segments.zh: 要把小植株分开，你需要保持无菌环境，并用消毒液处理工具，就像最初培养时那样。

segments.text: Later, as the plantlets reach a more mature size and form, you will transplant them, dividing plantlets again as necessary.
segments.zh: 之后，当小植株长到更成熟的大小和形态时，你要对它们进行移栽，必要时再次分株。

segments.text: Record these vitals as you monitor the growth chamber during the development process.
segments.zh: 在发育过程中监控培养箱时，请记录这些关键数据。

segments.text: These are the ingredients supporting plant cell formation and growth.
segments.zh: 这些是支持植物细胞形成和生长的成分。

segments.text: As described previously, the culture media must supply all necessary requirements because very little plant tissue is used in tissue culture.
segments.zh: 如前所述，由于组织培养中使用的植物组织很少，培养基必须提供所有必需的条件。

segments.text: Sucrose is a sugar source which provides natural carbon for tissue growth.
segments.zh: 蔗糖是一种糖源，为组织生长提供天然的碳。

segments.text: Vitamin B is naturally produced in the vegetative growth of plants. It's necessary for plantlet health.
segments.zh: 维生素 B 在植物的营养生长中自然产生，它对小植株的健康是必需的。

segments.text: Oxens are plant hormones that promote cell division and enlargement.
segments.zh: 生长素是促进细胞分裂和增大的植物激素。

segments.text: Agar is a sugar substance used to gel liquids.
segments.zh: 琼脂是一种用来使液体凝胶化的糖类物质。

segments.text: Remember how critical it is to maintain a safe and sterile workspace.
segments.zh: 记住，保持安全和无菌的工作空间是多么重要。

segments.text: As a review, mark or highlight three key points in your notes that are important to remember from this presentation.
segments.zh: 作为复习，请在笔记中标出或突出本讲解中需要记住的三个要点。

segments.text: List two ideas or concepts that relate to previous knowledge.
segments.zh: 列出两个与已有知识相关的观点或概念。

segments.text: List any questions you have about this topic. Discuss these questions with your instructor.
segments.zh: 列出你对这个主题的任何问题，并与老师讨论这些问题。

segments.text: Keep any notes you have from this presentation organized and available for use throughout the course.
segments.zh: 把本讲解的所有笔记整理好，以便在整个课程中随时使用。

segments.text: Through problem 424, the complete carrot, you will develop and write a protocol to insert a gene of interest in plants in order to understand how DNA can be cut,
segments.zh: 通过问题 4.2.4“完整的胡萝卜”，你将制定并撰写一份在植物中插入目的基因的实验方案，以理解 DNA 如何被切割、

segments.text: replicated, and inserted into the genome of an organism for the development of agricultural production.
segments.zh: 复制并插入生物体的基因组中，用于发展农业生产。

segments.text: Your teacher will provide more instructions.
segments.zh: 你的老师会提供进一步的说明。
